elements.text: In a LinkedIn post about our work during the GNI Audience Development Lab. see Blue Engine's

"You can shine a light on underreported stories in your communities to serve the greater good AND grow your audiences at the same time. San Francisco Public Press's strategic journey in the Google News Initiative Audience Development Lab is proof.

In only three months, their commitment to data-driven search engine optimization (SEO) and focusing on underserved stories led to a +196% increase in website sessions and an 18% rise in Google referrals, enhancing their mission and expanding their reach simultaneously.
Here's how their insights can universally apply:
Elevate your team's SEO skills to improve discoverability through slight adjustments in headlines, subheadings, internal links and metadata.
Use Google Trends and Search Console to align your reporting with the terms and topics your audiences search for, connecting with local and broader communities.

Leverage analytics to identify underreported stories where audiences are seeking information gaps in your communities. Don't just hit publish and forget it; continually update stories to keep audiences engaged and returning.

Adapt your editorial workflows using data to ensure your content resonates with audiences and sustains its value over time.

San Francisco Public Press's success story underscores the impact of dedicating resources to stories that matter yet often remain untold. This approach increases engagement and strengthens community connections, showcasing the incredible potential of thoughtful, targeted journalism.

Congratulations to Liana Wilcox, Lila LaHood, Lisa Rudman and the entire San Francisco Public Press team.

Inspired to see similar growth and make an impactful difference in your community? Blue Engine Collaborative can guide you. Connect with us to discover how we can help you expand your reach and deepen your engagement. Let's talk growth — contact David Grant."
